annotation.authors_or_issuer: Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST), Moonshot Goal 3 (PD: Kuniyoshi Yasuo)
annotation.venue: JST Moonshot Research and Development Program
annotation.summary_en: This is the Program Director's policy for the JST Moonshot Goal 3 call for proposals. Its target is general-purpose autonomous humanoid AI robots that act alongside humans by 2050. It sets out three funding categories (integrated, specialized, elemental) and the targets for 2030. It requires industry-academia collaboration and ELSI work, and asks for security safeguards in international collaboration.
key_provisions_or_claims: Integrated Research (up to 3 billion yen over 5 years) must combine a Task Execution Capability Team and a Robot Platform Team, and must address ELSI.
2030 target: a humanoid prototype that is suitable for private investment and can complete a series of tasks with human assistance.
Specialized (up to 1 billion yen) and Elemental (up to 100 million yen) categories; the program encourages young researchers to apply.
Projects may have their plans and budgets revised at interim evaluations to respond to fast-moving trends and national policies.
Proposals involving overseas collaboration must include security considerations.
